_comment: Single source of truth for the TWC app tutorial videos. Paths are relative to the Apps folder (the parent of this kit). Capture 'actions' drive each REAL app to a real screen (no fabricated backend data).

voice.note: Ryan = warm male. For a female voice set VOICE=en_US-amy-medium (or en_US-hfc_female-medium, en_US-lessac-medium).

scenes.title: Sign In
scenes.narr: Open Testimony Log and sign in with your name and access code.

scenes.title: Your Name
scenes.narr: Enter a name or nickname, and the access code from church leadership.

scenes.title: Ask the Biblical AI
scenes.narr: Tap Ask AI to open the built-in Biblical assistant.

scenes.title: Ask a Question
scenes.narr: Ask about Scripture, theology, or Christian living.

actions.text: What does the Bible say about faith?

qr.file: QR code converter/Website to QR Code.html

scenes.title: Enter a URL
scenes.narr: Open the QR generator and paste any website link.

scenes.title: Live Preview
scenes.narr: Your QR code appears instantly as you type.

scenes.title: Download as PNG
scenes.narr: Save it as a PNG image. It works completely offline.

scenes.title: Squish!
scenes.narr: In Squish, little ones tap the colourful shapes to pop them.

scenes.title: God Loves You
scenes.narr: Bible Squish fills the screen with God's love.

scenes.title: Rainbow Drawing
scenes.narr: In God's Rainbow Drawing, they scribble in bright colours.

scenes.title: Unlock
scenes.narr: Open Family Tasks and unlock with your family name and password.

scenes.title: Register a Family
scenes.narr: New here? Register your family to start a shared task list.

scenes.title: Sign In
scenes.narr: Open Family Budget and sign in with your family name and password.

scenes.title: Register a Family
scenes.narr: Register a new family to start tracking income and expenses.

scenes.title: Create Account
scenes.narr: Open TWC Strong and create your private account.

scenes.title: How To
scenes.narr: A built-in How-To explains logging sets, routines, and progress.

scenes.title: Search Hymns
scenes.narr: Open TWC Hymns and search by title, author, or first line.

scenes.title: Admin Access
scenes.narr: Admins can unlock hymn management to add new songs.

scenes.title: Our Week
scenes.narr: Open Our Week — the shared Monday-to-Sunday family planner.

scenes.title: Add a Family
scenes.narr: Create a family, each with its own password, to start planning.
